title: Second Story
about: Bring a half-dead apartment building back to life. Repair one thing at a time, win over stubborn tenants, and watch the place remember what it was.

controls.desc: Select apartments and use the labelled controls.
Tap the visible top-bar control to advance time. Space is optional.
Tap the visible top-bar control to save or quit. Esc is optional.

extra_sections.heading: Features
extra_sections.body:
- Progressive Building Unlock - Complete challenges to unlock harder properties
- Six Campaign Buildings - From starter apartments to historic manor estates
- Tenant System - Diverse archetypes with unique needs and stories
- Building Upgrades - Improve hallways, install facilities, upgrade designs
